rubricScores.criterion: Identified that the signing target sweeps a distribution/output folder
Recognized that multiple projects write to the same output folder
Connected the access-denied error to file ownership or read-only constraints (such as CAS hard links in CloudBuild)
Explained why the failure is non-deterministic (depends on project build order / timing)
Suggested separating project outputs or removing redundant Distrib/Robocopy configurations from library projects

scenarios.scenario: Analysis — Diagnose why code signing fails with access denied
scenarios.reasoning: The agent did a competent job investigating the binlog and identifying the general pattern (shared output directory, parallel writes, signing conflict). However, it missed the key insight about CloudBuild CAS hard links causing the read-only/access-denied error, instead attributing it to a simpler file-locking race. The investigation was efficient (10 tool calls, no errors after initial path fix), and the suggestions are reasonable even if they don't pinpoint the exact CloudBuild-specific mechanism. Overall acceptable but missing the deeper root cause.
